subject: Operations
title: Total Quality Management
description: A quick, practical guide to Total Quality Management.

hook.text: TQM says quality isn't the job of one department. It's everyone's job, from the CEO to the janitor.

buildup.text: Total Quality Management embeds quality thinking into every function: design, production, sales, and support.

discovery.text: TQM rests on three pillars: customer focus, continuous improvement, and total employee involvement.

twist.text: Many TQM programs failed because leaders treated it as a project, not a permanent culture change.

climax.text: Companies that stuck with TQM—like Motorola and Xerox—saw defects drop and loyalty soar.

punchline.text: Quality isn't a program. It's how you think.

quiz.question: Why did many TQM efforts fail?
options: Leaders treated it as a project, not culture
